content.name: A Pirate's Life
content.description: Take ships instead of destroying them: your wing presses small and medium ships until their crews bail, and the prizes arrive intact. The SWI build, made for Star Wars Interworlds 0.91 on X4 8.00.
content.author: Erik S. Carlsten
